name: How long does a typical paver installation take with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical paver installation take with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a paver installation varies depending on the project's scope and complexity. A standalone paver patio might take less time than a comprehensive outdoor living space that includes an outdoor kitchen, covered patio, and extensive paver work. During our design phase, we establish a detailed project timeline, providing transparency regarding demolition, site preparation, installation, and final touches. Our commitment to a managed process ensures efficient execution, minimizing disruption while upholding our standards of craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration for paver installation varies by scope, from standalone patios to complex outdoor living spaces. We provide transparent timelines during the design phase to manage expectations.
